notes:
Summary:
- Account: trading analytics + real-time personalization for price/offer ranking. Extremely latency-sensitive reranking path (inline in order decision pipeline).
- Priority: p50 <50ms, p99 <120ms under 200 req/s sustained. Cost sensitivity: wants unit economics visibility; open to dedicated commit if per-token cost predictable.
- Technical asks: deterministic p99 benchmarking harness (per-route), ability to run consistent perf tests over night load, GPU reservation for repeated runs. Interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batch sizes, quant profiles) and in continuous KV/prefix caching to hit hot-path cache rates.
POC notes:
- We ran baseline unquantized model first (customer-provided reranker). Median good but p99 spikes on long context and cold KV misses.
- Hypothesis from SE: batching tuning + prefix caching + int8 quantization will get p99 inside target while lowering cost by ~35%. Ran quick int8 sweep: latency ok but ~0.6% accuracy delta on rare queries — customer flagged as a blocker for acceptance.
- Customer request: show token-level cost breakouts in the POC report, and a deterministic replay of 50k real requests to reproduce p99 numbers. Wants per-route fallback rule: when p99 >150ms route to lightweight model (lower cost) until cluster recovers.
Security/compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML for all engineer logins, KMS integration for key rotation, SOC2 evidence needed before procurement. Retention: 30-day logs + ability to whitelist exceptions.
Commercial:
- Budget: internal cap ~ $500k ARR target for year 1. Prefers annual committed Dedicated contract if SLO + perf report acceptable.
Quotes / direct: 'If we can't get p99 under 120ms consistently, this will stay in a pilot forever' — CTO.
Next steps (detailed):
- SE: run full 50k replay with current quant profile + batching config; share raw latency histograms (p50/p95/p99) and token cost per request (by route). Target delivery 2026-03-10.
- Infra: provision dedicated cluster for repeatable runs; hold GPU buffer for final stress test.
- Security: Redwood security to deliver SOC2 section + retention controls doc; customer to return signed NDA for deeper logs.
